query_independence_note: 140 unique source clips, not 560 independent observations; two queries per person and nested gallery stages remain correlated.
stage_prevalence_caveat: Intended known/foreign counts are10/130,20/120,40/100,100/40. Precision/F1 differences combine changing gallery size with changing class prevalence; they are not an isolated distractor or scalability effect.
controlled_gallery_scope: Qualified single-row enrollment clips are labeled supervised gallery templates; sequential novelty fusion is NOT executed. This isolates matching with fixed planned gallery sizes and does not measure automatic new-person registration.
conflict_diagnostics_scope: Validated native peer ordinals and source speech ranges retained. Same-predicted-profile pairs with native exclusion or positive temporal overlap counted separately; actual MeetingMemory.conflicting_assignment is NOT invoked and pure-fuser decisions remain unchanged. Not a final persistence-decision claim.
matching_numeric_scope: Controlled CPU cosine does not claim PostgreSQL SIMD bitwise equality; 1e-6 boundary proximity is reported for followup, never adjusted.
limitations: Controlled single-clip matching and real private-provider extraction, not end-to-end meeting/DB evidence.
Supervised gallery insertion bypasses sequential novelty enrollment; per-track pure fusion bypasses final persistence conflict enforcement, which is diagnosed separately.
Corpus readers now overlap observed whole-meeting experiments; this is a frozen regression view, not a fresh blind holdout.
English audiobook chapters do not establish Turkish meeting/microphone/session or pretrained-person independence.
Nested stages are correlated, not 560 independent probes.
